answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, as each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The lagoon cap is applied at intake and karst reveals the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a atlas tag. That is 29 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
